title: Proposed study collaboration on Gaucher disease

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on Gaucher disease
Dear International Gaucher Alliance, National Gaucher Foundation and Gauchers Association team, each of you supports people living with Gaucher disease.
I am [name, role, institution], and I would value your view on a study idea.
Published work describes a lysosomal enzyme deficiency in which glucosylceramide builds up.
Protein misfolding is also proposed, but this is contested, as some data question whether ambroxol acts as a chaperone for every enzyme variant.
Two recruiting registries include people with Gaucher disease: a lysosomal storage disease registry and an institutional rare disease registry.
Eliglustat and velaglucerase trials have completed, and a venglustat trial in type 3 is active but not recruiting.
Enzyme replacement and eliglustat are approved but do not reach the brain.
We would propose [study aim and design], built with your communities and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and how your members or these registries could take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If you are open to it, could we arrange a short call?
